For all addresses, the sum of tokens transferred equals v times the number of recipients processed (all recipients in reference, every other recipient in mutant).
After calling transfer, the number of times the external call succeeds is equal to the number of recipients processed (all recipients in C, every other in M).
After calling transfer, the number of accounts that are in the _tos array and have a token balance change after the call is exactly the length of _tos (i.e., every recipient is processed).
After transfer, the number of distinct recipient addresses that have a nonzero token balance change equals the total number of recipients in the _tos array.
After calling transfer, the total number of token transfers executed (as measured by the cumulative gas used by the external calls) is exactly equal to the length of the _tos array.
